name: ASTA Energy Solutions AG
summary: ASTA Energy Solutions AG produces and sells copper-based solutions for high-performance power transmission, generation, and e-mobility applications. It offers Roebelbars for use in generators; continuously transposed conductors for power and distribution transformers; and transaction transformer for rail transportation, as well as copper hairpins for electric motors. The company was formerly known as ASTA Energy Transmission Components GmbH and change its name to ASTA Energy Solutions AG in August 2023. ASTA Energy Solutions AG was founded in 2005 and is based in Wiener Neustadt, Austria.
